_note: Morehouse College rules are quoted verbatim from the college's published
Outside Counsel Guidelines, with real section letters and page numbers.
Apex Technologies is a fictional client and its guidelines are invented.
The document name says so, so a citation never claims to be something it is not.
Matters must also exist as tasks in the database, because resolve() reads SQL:
Apex Technologies  -> Antitrust Litigation, Horizon Acquisition

rules.section: Section F.1, Team Size and Composition
rules.excerpt: Generally, only a single representative from your firm should be present unless the complexity of the situation justifies additional personnel, subject to the supervising attorney's prior approval.

rules.section: Section E.4, Management of Non-Attorney Costs
rules.excerpt: The engagement of experts and similar non-attorney expenses must receive advance approval, with requests for expert involvement to include a projected budget for their services.
If billed, travel time is chargeable at 50% of the standard rate, unless productive work is performed during travel, which must then be detailed in the invoice.
Requests exceeding $1,000 per item need prior OGC approval and should be processed directly.

rules.document: Apex Technologies Outside Counsel Guidelines (sample, fictional)
rules.excerpt: Timekeepers who do not appear on the approved staffing plan require written authorization from the supervising attorney before performing any billable work.

rules.document: Apex Technologies Outside Counsel Guidelines (sample, fictional)
